name: Secrets of KL - Nightlife, Street Art & Cocktails!
tagline: KL After Dark - Speakeasies, Street Art and Street Food
shortDescription: Simply Enak's after-dark crawl reveals hidden speakeasy bars, classic Malaysian food and the forbidden tales of the red-light district.
fullDescription:
Are you ready to step into the hidden corners of Kuala Lumpur's nightlife? Let's get started with a locally inspired cocktail, or if you're keen a craft beer infused with typically Malaysian flavours.

A young and entrepreneurial group of business owners is slowly changing the way Kuala Lumpur and specifically Petaling Street looks. Much of this change is happening in secret, behind obscure doors. What used to be brothels are now trendy, underground, pubs and cocktail bars. They blend in really well with the traditional street food that has been served in this area for many years now.

We'll walk the alleys as well as some of the train stations' street art and murals. Enjoy stories of the night, vices and how they have shaped the capital city of Malaysia. Dinner will be served at one of the must-eat street food stalls whilst you will be entertained with stories of the city's history and culture; food for thought as well as the stomach!

This tour comes with a secret dish, only to be announced on the day of the tour. Speaking of food, we will make sure your stomach is taken care of as well with a sample of the snacks locals queue for after midnight, clay pot chicken rice and more. Also indulge in a must-have dish when in Kuala Lumpur, one of the Rendangs that take all day to cook  -  and sixty seconds to disappear!

Looking for a different kind of night fun and learning more about the city of Kuala Lumpur in the process? Then this is your tour. Catch a glimpse of KL's hidden nightlife today!

name: Penang Street Food
shortDescription: What makes Penang the "food capital" of Malaysia? Simply Enak will guide you through the cultural fusion that created dishes you'll only find here. At Chowrasta Market, we'll dare you to try kopitiam "Ngor Ka Sai".
fullDescription:
Penang is known in Malaysia as the food capital and what better way than to eat your way through the street food this island has to offer? As we walk past the monuments of Penang we take a step back to the time when Penang was formed as a settlement.

As we try different dishes we step into the traditions and culture that make Penang food the kind you remember months later. Have a light (or no) breakfast to prepare for all the local favorites such as Roti Chennai, Penang Laksa, Nasi Lemak and more.

name: Kuala Lumpur Street Food
tagline: The Heart of KL Street Food
shortDescription: Brand new to Malaysia? This is everything you need to know! Simply Enak will guide you through major temples and historic lanes in Chinatown, stopping at stalls that locals swear by.
fullDescription:
When you think of Malaysia, you think of food, Street Food! And what's a better way to dive into Malaysian Street Food than taking a stroll through the Heart of Kuala Lumpur, the Heritage Zone? The Kuala Lumpur Street Food Experience is a great way for any first-time visitor to see how food and culture feed each other in Malaysia.

During our walk, you will taste, smell and hear a great variety of cultural influences that makes Malaysia's culture and food so diverse and memorable. On this tour, you will visit local tradesmen, street food vendors and shops hidden from the eyes of tourists. Witness the daily life of local Malaysians as you sample some of the same banana-leaf rice and pulled teh tarik that fuel this city. This experience is a great way to get a helicopter view of Malaysian Food and Culture. Bring your kids along, this is a kid friendly Food Experience!

name: Flavours of Malaysia
shortDescription: Brand new to Malaysia? This is everything you need to know! Simply Enak will guide you through major temples and historic lanes in Chinatown, stopping at stalls that have been feeding KL for decades. Perfect introduction to Malaysian culture and heritage.
fullDescription:
What's a better place to experience a country than a market? On this excursion, we take you through one of the largest wet markets in Kuala Lumpur. You will experience first-hand the sights, smells and flavours of the different cultures of Malaysia, hence its title flavours of Malaysia.

Imagine rows of local fruits, vegetables and spices that are on display along with an array of stalls selling the freshest meat and seafood. Walking through the market, you'll taste popular Malaysian dishes, as well as, understand the key ingredients used in the kitchens of the three main cultures of Malaysia. This market experience is 100% real which means you may experience, see and smell things that are not present in markets in other parts of our world.

name: Eat Drink George Town
tagline: Street Food and Cocktails in Penang
shortDescription: Hungry for Georgetown's greatest hits? Simply Enak's most-loved Penang tour starts as the sun sets and Georgetown comes alive. Three cultures' evening delights.
fullDescription:
Eat Drink George Town is the perfect food trail for small groups who would like to taste Penang's street food  -  from wok-fried char kway teow to nutmeg cocktails shaken tableside. This evening tour takes you around the heritage zone of Penang where we will walk and talk you through the stories that have shaped Penang into what it is today, a fusion of cultures and food worth crossing town for.

On this tour, we will visit hawker stalls from various ethnic backgrounds and learn the stories of these hawkers. One of the highlights is a visit to a Clan Jetty including a taste of the Char Kway Teow that draws queues from across Penang. We end the experience on a happy note at a famous Penang cocktail bar and let the bartender shake up a cocktail using local ingredients and spices.

Come hungry and ready for a fun experience. Our Penang-born guide is ready to share his stories of food, culture and the people of Penang.
